tests.name: Only the first panel is open
tests.code:
const panels = $("#faqs .ui-accordion-content");
return panels.length === 3 && panels.eq(0).is(":visible") && panels.eq(1).is(":hidden");

questions.prompt: Create an Accordion from `#faqs` with these **options**: all panels can be closed (`collapsible`), **no** panel is open at the start (`active: false`), panels open on **mouseover** instead of click (`event`), and each panel is only as tall as its content (`heightStyle: "content"`).

tests.name: Options are set
tests.code:
const a = $("#faqs");
return a.accordion("option", "collapsible") === true && a.accordion("option", "active") === false && a.accordion("option", "event") === "mouseover" && a.accordion("option", "heightStyle") === "content";

questions.title: Plugin options with $.extend()
questions.prompt: Write a plugin `truncate` that shortens the text of each selected element. It takes an options object; use `$.extend()` to merge it with these **defaults**: `{ length: 20, ending: "…" }`. Text longer than `length` is cut to `length` characters plus `ending`. Use `this.each()` and return its result.
